lines.text: Rusty just got struck by lightning.
Three hundred million volts hit him in a split second.
The air around him heats up to thirty thousand degrees.
That's five times hotter than the surface of the Sun.
But most of the current doesn't even go inside him.
His sweat instantly turns to steam, and blasts his shoes right off.
Red, fern-like patterns bloom across his skin.
The real danger? The shock can stop his heart.
Luckily, about nine out of ten people survive.
Just don't hide under a tree in a storm.
